table.name: TLGNC_RAIL_DISTANCE
table.description: Distances between railway stations used by Crh. The distances given by SBB are 'tariff-kilometers' and are used for cost calculation per kilometer. Tariff-kilometers typically differfrom the actual travel-distances.

column.name: DEP_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. Departure Railway station. These are Brunnen, Cornaux, Eclepens, Siggenthal-Wurenlingen, Zizers SBB.

column.name: TARIFF_DISTANCE_M
column.description: The distance between departure and arrival station, expressed in tariff-METERS. The distance from A to B is the same as B to A, only one is stored in this table.
